en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a wooded valley with scattered villas and farmhouses along a winding road. In the foreground stands an ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa with a turret and steep roof, surrounded by a garden and fence. Further back, more detached houses lie among trees, with forested hills and terraced fields rising in the background. The style evokes a Central European spa or resort village in a mountainous region. Along the bottom border there are some hand‑written or printed alphanumeric marks, but no clear title or caption.
